title: Contribution Workflow
definition: The systematic process that enables users to contribute their minted concepts to a public repository, ensuring authenticity and integrity of the content.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it as a recipe for getting your new ideas onto a shared platform. It saves your work as a file, and then you can share it with others for them to check and add.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The contribution workflow is a series of steps that allows users to submit their concept in JSON format, which is then authenticated and added to the repository. This ensures the integrity and accuracy of the content.
difficulty_levels.expert: The contribution workflow is a novel application of blockchain technology in a knowledge management system. It combines the distributed nature of blockchain with the structure of JSON to create a decentralized, tamper-proof system for knowledge contribution. It also highlights the potential for using blockchain in community-driven content creation and validation.

extra_fields.insight: The contribution workflow combines the structure of JSON with the distributed nature of blockchain to create a decentralized, tamper-proof system for knowledge contribution.
